'''Unarmed Middleweight Champion''' was a title that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admirals]] could get by winning an unarmed fighting competition. [[Nova Stihl]] won this competition twice and was also twice runner-up.
